The main takeaway from our work is that
the ITT estimand should be supplemented with other estimands that compare treatment strategies that are clinically relevant and that can be implemented.
the E9 Addendon and other guidelines should not be used as recipes for statistical analysis but rather as a basis for discussion among all parties involved in the design and conduct of trials.
